question: What was the prevalence of self-reported goitre or thyroid disorder in the National Family Health Survey [NFHS - V (2019 - 2021)]?
solution: The correct answer is __**2.9%**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The prevalence of **self-reported goitre or thyroid disorder** in the **National Family Health Survey V {NFHS-V (2019-2021)}** was** 2.9%**. • While in** NFHS IV (2015-2016)**, it was **2.2%**. • It is believed that iodine supplementation can cause a spurt in autoimmune thyroid dysfunction and hypothyroidism by making the thyroid gland more susceptible to damage by the body’s own immune system.
